status: Round 3 scored (11:10 AM ET). Running until ~1:00 PM ET: 2-hour versions of the best four (h3dec_vid, h3dec_vid_nogan, refiner_tok, pixreg_gan)
verdict: So far: H3's latent holds only a little more than H3's own decoder extracts, and nothing beats H3's decoder by eye. On video (tiled whole-clip latents), H3's decoder fine-tuned for 1 hour gains +0.27 dB and DISTS -0.002 (both significant) but is softer and flickers more, and blind judges cannot tell it from H3's decode; every decoder trained from scratch in 1 hour is far behind (-3.4 dB). On single images the best sampler (a refiner of H3's decode with the latent and the DWD tokens) gains +0.77 dB and DISTS -0.006 and ties H3 by eye; regression decoders win every metric (up to +2.6 dB) and lose by eye. For video, H3's decoder already extracts nearly all that a 1-hour decoder can find.
